sources.title: NVIDIA L40S Specs | TechPowerUp GPU Database
sources.snippet: The L40S was a professional graphics card by NVIDIA, launched on August 23rd, 2023. Built on the 5 nm process, and based on the AD102GL graphics processor, in its AD102-896-A1 variant, the card supports DirectX 12 Ultimate.

sources.title: L40S GPU for AI and Graphics Performance | NVIDIA
sources.snippet: The Most Powerful Universal GPU Experience breakthrough multi-workload performance with the NVIDIA L40S GPU. Combining powerful AI compute with best-in-class graphics and media acceleration, the L40S GPU is built to power the next generation of data center workloads—from generative AI and large language model (LLM) inference and training to 3D graphics, rendering, and video.
